stem: The same irrigation program is used on small and large containers, but the small containers dry much faster. What should the technician report?
choices: Container size and root-zone volume differ, so the shared program may not produce equivalent water availability
The smaller containers must contain a different nutrient recipe
Dryback is unrelated to container volume
Increase irrigation in every zone without documenting the pattern
rationale: Container volume affects water storage and dryback. A shared program may not create the same root-zone conditions across container sizes.
